title: lathyrus luteus subalpinus
intro: Lathyrus luteus subalpinus, commonly known as the Alpine Pea or Yellow Pea, is a subspecies of the Lathyrus luteus plant, which belongs to the Fabaceae family of flowering plants. It is known for its bright yellow flowers and has been used in traditional medicine for its potential health benefits, which include reducing inflammation and improving cardiovascular health. The therapeutic actions of Lathyrus luteus subalpinus include anti-inflammatory, antioxidant, and vasodilatory effects, making it a potential treatment for conditions such as hypertension and atherosclerosis. The bioactive constituents of this plant include alkaloids, glycosides, and flavonoids, which contribute to its therapeutic properties.
